content:
alex: heads-up — noticed prefix cache hit-rate for prefix="/search" dropped from ~92% to ~58% over the last 6h in prod, any quick pointers where to look?
maya: try the cache-prefetch Grafana dashboard — panels for prefix_hit_rate and eviction_rate. link: https://grafana.redwood.net/d/abcd/cache-prefetch
maya: main PromQL we use for panel is:
```
sum(rate(kv_prefix_hits_total{env="prod"}[5m])) / sum(rate(kv_prefix_requests_total{env="prod"}[5m]))
```
liam: looks like evictions spiked around 2026-03-16T18:10Z, check the eviction_rate panel and node memory on the runtime pool.
alex: where do I get the raw logs/traces for a particular request id?
sasha: use Loki + Tempo links from the dashboard, but quick Loki query:
```
{job="kv-cache", env="prod"} |= \"prefix=/search\" | logfmt | line_format \"ts={{.ts}} req_id={{.req_id}} evicted={{.evicted}} hit={{.hit}}\"
```
sasha: then click trace links in the log row to jump to Tempo if available.
ops-bot: Alert: prefix_cache_hit_rate_low fired for alert_id=PC-317 (severity=page) at 2026-03-16T18:12:05Z
maya: oh that alert is noisy for transient GC/eviction spikes, we should consider increasing the eval_window to 15m or lower the severity to warning.
liam: agreed — suggestion: change rule to evaluate over 15m and require 3 consecutive evals before firing. current rule: threshold < 0.7 over 5m.
alex: is that a quick alert tweak or do we want an RFC?
sasha: quick tweak as a stopgap, open ticket for follow-up to investigate root cause (maybe rollout of prefix-cache-v2?).
alex: i did a quick grep and found a deploy earlier today: deploy-bot: deployed prefix-cache-v2 to prod at 2026-03-16T14:30Z — PR: https://git.redwood.net/r/prefix-cache/pulls/421
liam: pinging eng-runtime to check memory/eviction knobs — @sasha can you loop them in?
sasha: @eng-runtime-crew ^ please eyeball evictions for prefix=/search, + any recent kernel or driver changes on the pool nodes.
ops-bot: Note: runbook link for alert PC-317: https://runbooks.redwood.net/pc-317-cache-hit-low.md
maya: for quick triage: 1) check eviction_rate panel, 2) open a sample log in Loki for a few req_ids, 3) check node memory and OOM events.
alex: ok running queries now, will paste results in thread shortly.
liam: if we need to mute the page while triaging, we can move PC-317 to P2 temporarily — i'll open a short-lived change in alertmanager.
sasha: created ticket RW-7891 to track postmortem and dashboard tweaks: https://jira.redwood.net/browse/RW-7891
alex: thanks all — will update once I confirm if it's transient or correlates with prefix-cache-v2 rollout. :thumbsup:
maya: if helpful, add a small panel to the dashboard showing per-prefix request distribution (top 20 prefixes) so we can spot sudden skew.
sasha: good idea, I'll add a PR for the Grafana dashboard and link it here when ready.
alex: quick paste of my local PromQL snapshot results (5m / 15m):
```
5m_hit_rate: 0.59
15m_hit_rate: 0.88
```
alex: that suggests a short-lived drop, probably evictions/heat shuffle. keeping an eye.
liam: thanks — keep us posted.
maya: thx alex, appreciate the ping. :ripe_fruit:
